verdict.rationale: While Zulip exposes a full REST API and CLI tooling (zulip-probe-5, zulip-probe-6, zulip-docs-5) that could theoretically be scripted, the evidence pack contains no documentation or hands-on proof of a bulk/batch endpoint (e.g., mass message updates, bulk channel management, batch subscribe/unsubscribe) that lets an AI-native user act on many items in one call. missing for 10: documented bulk-update/bulk-delete/batch endpoints, evidence of batch request support, any example of operating on multiple items in a single API call.
